params.comment: repo: the GitHub repo to read, default this checkout's origin. branch_prefix: the branch a Claude Code Projects cloud thread starts, claude/. window_days: how far back draft_first_share reads merged PRs. weeks: how many 7-day buckets tokens_per_merged_pr compares. idle_minutes: the project cache lifetime, one hour. projects_dir: where Claude Code keeps session transcripts; a ~/ path is under home. project_match: names no path here, the default is the repo's own project folder. subagents_dir: the folder of a session's subagent transcripts. human_origin: the origin kind of a record a person typed.

label: Thread PRs opened as drafts
means: Merged pull requests from claude/ branches that were drafts when opened, so CI runs before a person reads them.
goal_source: goal from the Projects docs: the example project instructions say "Branch from main and open one draft pull request per thread" (code.claude.com/docs/en/claude-projects, Write project instructions, read 2026-11-25), so every thread's PR starts as a draft
source: gh api graphql: the merged pullRequests of the last params.window_days (30) days whose branch starts with params.branch_prefix, up to the latest 100 by update; a PR counts as opened as a draft when its first ready-for-review or convert-to-draft event is ready-for-review (state, N = 100 PRs at most)

label: Sessions revived after an idle hour
means: Sessions that a person resumed after more than an hour idle, so the whole conversation was read again.
goal_source: goal from the Projects docs: the cache lifetime is an hour on Pro, Max and Ultra, and a thread idle longer than that re-reads its whole conversation when a follow-up reaches it, so new work starts a fresh thread (code.claude.com/docs/en/claude-projects, See and reduce a project's usage, read 2026-11-25); the docs give no count, so one a week is a template choice
source: the last 7 days of this repo's session transcripts, main sessions only: a record a person typed (params.human_origin) more than params.idle_minutes (60) after the session's previous record; N = 7 days

label: Tokens per merged thread PR, 4-week change
means: How much the tokens spent per merged claude/ pull request rose or fell from the oldest week to the latest.
goal_source: template goal, no public benchmark: the Projects docs say a project uses plan limits faster than one session and show usage by thread (code.claude.com/docs/en/claude-projects, See and reduce a project's usage, read 2026-11-25), so the cost of a merged PR falls or holds, never rises; zero change is the goal
source: params.weeks (4) buckets of 7 days: billable tokens (input, output and cache write, one count per message id, cache reads left out) of this repo's session transcripts, subagents included, divided by the merged PRs from params.branch_prefix branches of the same week (gh api graphql, up to the latest 100 by update); the change from the oldest bucket with both to the latest; N = 4 weeks
